description: Connect this keyless session to the user's own account, the way `gh auth login` works. Ask for their email first and pass it (it prefills the page). Returns a one-time url and a code: open the url in their browser yourself and tell them the code. They sign up or log in ON THE PAGE (never ask for a password in chat), check the code matches, and press Connect. From then on this session acts as their account and the games built so far move in. The link lasts 10 minutes.

email.description: The user's email, to prefill the sign-in page.

name: connect_account
title: Connect this session to the user's account
